## Summary
What changed and why? Link related issues.

## Verification
List exact checks run and their results. Distinguish scripted fixtures from live-model tests.

## Compatibility and security
Describe API/configuration changes, side effects, permissions, or deployment implications.

## Checklist
- [ ] The scope is focused and consistent with the design principles in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- [ ] Behavioral changes have regression tests.
- [ ] Relevant docs/examples and CHANGELOG.md are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or generated build artifacts are included.
- [ ] I stated skipped or failing checks instead of claiming success.
